summary: Ansible 14 removed awx.awx (24.6.1), cisco.dnac (6.41.0) and junipernetworks.junos (11.0.0), which can still be installed manually.
questions: Which collections were removed in Ansible 14?
Is awx.awx still in the Ansible 14 package?
How do I keep using junipernetworks.junos with Ansible 14?

answer_card.title: Collections removed in Ansible 14
answer_card.answer_md:
Removed from Ansible 14:

- awx.awx (was 24.6.1)
- cisco.dnac (was 6.41.0)
- junipernetworks.junos (was 11.0.0)

Install manually if needed:

```bash
ansible-galaxy collection install <name-of-collection>
```
